job.job_description:
Design, develop, and maintain high-quality backend systems using various technologies.


Collaborate with frontend developers to integrate backend services with web applications.


Develop and implement automated testing frameworks to ensure code quality.


Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues efficiently.


Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving overall code quality.


Work closely with the product team to identify and prioritize project requirements.




Job Requirements




Strong understanding of software development principles and patterns.


Experience with backend development technologies such as Java, Python, or Ruby.


Familiarity with database management systems like MySQL or PostgreSQL.


Knowledge of API design principles and versioning strategies.


Understanding of testing frameworks such as JUnit or PyUnit.


Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
